verified_defect: P45-I retains a previously positive factual ABA fast effect across a non-ABA actual causal reversal and still declares factual_ready true after the reversal observation; old effect 0.3, new actual effect -0.3.
hypothesis: An optional factual freshness sidecar can prevent selecting actions from a stale fast ABA estimate while preserving the original P43 recurrent belief, factual ABA memory and cold checkpoints unchanged.

implementation_scope.fast_estimator: same P45-I actual A,-A,A contrast, no additional source data
implementation_scope.freshness: last successful completed ABA contrast observation step equals current factual observation step
implementation_scope.stale_preview: fallback to original P43-R1 rank-qualified recurrent prediction but factual_ready=false
implementation_scope.fresh_selection: original P45-I choice with no change to model parameters
implementation_scope.same-state_speculation: read-only; no factual state, freshness or learned weights change
implementation_scope.cold_state: original P43/P43-R1/P45-I tensors plus last successful ABA factual step

limits: A hidden mode reversal is unknowable before an informative factual observation; freshness is not mode-change detection
Even fresh A,-A,A estimates can be biased when mode switch straddles evidence or nuisance changes nonlinearly
Lower decision coverage is an intended fail-closed tradeoff, not demonstrated learning improvement
No superiority over zero-training ABA, P46 five-action contrast, fully trained conventional GRU/MLP, or strong ridge
P46 frozen science DEV FAIL 0/3; do not reuse its consumed source as independent science
